data.title: Air Quality and Health Equity
data.snippet: Map series presenting data on six air pollutant measures of the EPA's 2021 release of the Environmental Justice Screen 2.0 tool in relation to the MRMPO Vulnerability Index census tract demographics indicating relative concentrations of populations of concern for environmental justice - persons with incomes below poverty, persons of color, and of Hispanic/Latine ethnic origins.  Additional demographic measures of populations of concern for health vulnerability taken from the Social Vulnerability Index of the CDC (such as children, seniors, and persons with disabilities) are also included in pop-up windows by clicking on individual tracts within the map.  The tool is provided to assist in performance of environmental justice assessments of disproportionate environmental health impacts, and inform actions to support improved and equitable health outcomes.
